text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I walk down the hallway, I spot
Mejiro
McQueen coming my direction,
looking unwell.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I'm fine. Yes, I'm having no trouble at all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
As a proud member of the esteemed
Mejiro
family, I shall endure... a
headache as minor as
this one.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro McQueen is suffering from a
headache.
